written_before: any CAL/DEV candidate pool is scored (only a 2-problem CAL smoke may have run)
why: The audit shows <Learn2Reg case ids withheld> are presumed TEST134-derived and the bundle has no landmarks, so the Learn2Reg validation TRE cannot be reproduced locally; the host is instead run on our own CAL/DEV cores with exact synthetic truth.
metric: primary: grid TRE = mean |q + u(q) - T(q)| over a 16x16 interior grid of the 832 patch (full-res px), strict <9 / loose <42 (CoMIR 1 % / 5 %), core-macro over the 10 draws then mean over cores; secondary: patch-corner error (CoMIR definition), median, p95.
pool: per problem 183 candidates = per round the XFeat affine init + 60 iterates; candidates with <64 valid positions are ineligible for learned/soft-MI rules

rules.NATIVE: Neon rule exactly (per round max MI over iterates on that round's k-means labels, best round); recomputed from the recorded pool and checked equal to the host output
rules.SOFTMI: argmax our 64-bin Parzen MI (BF luminance vs log SHG at the 512-frame scale, valid positions)
rules.VCS_J: argmax exact J of the long-v2 30k vcs_exact encoder (per seed 1001-1003)
rules.BCE: argmax BCE objective score of the bce encoder (per seed)
rules.NCE: argmax InfoNCE (tau .07) score of the nce encoder (per seed)
rules.COS_<arm>: argmax mean cosine for each encoder (readout control)
rules.ORACLE: argmin grid TRE (diagnostic only, never a method)

comparisons: primary: VCS_J - NATIVE on DEV strict (paired by seed: seed s of VCS_J vs the single NATIVE); secondary: VCS_J - BCE, VCS_J - NCE (same seed), each also loose / median / p95; all split by DEV cores seen vs not seen in Neon training (AUDIT_SUMMARY).
signal_rule: descriptive: "VCS selection gain" if VCS_J - NATIVE >= +3 pp strict with >= 2/3 seeds positive and p95 not worse; "VCS-specific" additionally needs VCS_J - max(BCE, NCE) >= +2 pp strict with >= 2/3 seeds. Not significance tests; DEV has been used across many rounds.
decomposition: per problem at strict 9 px: pool miss (ORACLE >= 9), native selection error (ORACLE < 9 and NATIVE >= 9), and for each rule rescued / broken counts relative to NATIVE
stop: after stage 1; no stage-2/3 training; no DeeperHistReg tuning on DEV (if run, CAL-only configuration)
